description: This file defines the WorkShiftAPI class for managing work shift data via RESTful endpoints in an HR management system. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting work shifts, with validation rules and route annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: WorkShiftAPI
classes.description: API controller class for managing work shifts, providing REST endpoints for CRUD operations, with integrated validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all work shifts, applying filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve details of a specific work shift by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new work shift with provided data.

methods.name: setParamsToWorkShift
methods.description: Assigns request parameters to a WorkShift entity instance for create/update operations.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing work shifts.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single work shift by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing work shift identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a work shift.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove one or more work shifts by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation.
